releaseNotes:
Fix release workflow breaking on special chars in commit message

Render latest.json interpolated github.event.head_commit.message
directly into a shell string, so a commit message containing double
quotes (or parens/newlines) broke the shell and failed the step with
exit 127 -- which is what aborted the v0.2.4 release. Pass the message
and event name via env vars instead, per GitHub's safe pattern; also
closes a script-injection vector.
